content: Vikram Patel from Omni Insurance calls Atharv Pandey regarding the renewal of health policy HP-785412, which is set to expire today. Atharv decides not to renew the policy because he is switching to another provider and requests a cancellation. Vikram confirms he will mark the policy as expired effective today and send a confirmation email.

action_items: Mark health policy HP-785412 as expired in the system
Send a policy cancellation/expiration confirmation email to the customer
